description: Private network profile and handover (section 13): legacy v3/v1 transition vectors and hybrid Ed25519+ML-DSA-65 v4/v2 vectors with strict-AND and no-downgrade rejections.

hybridRejected.name: profileV4MissingMldsaSignature
hybridRejected.description: adminDsaPublicKey present without signatureMldsa65 must be rejected (§13.1).

hybridRejected.name: profileV4MissingAdminDsaKey
hybridRejected.description: signatureMldsa65 present without adminDsaPublicKey must be rejected (§13.1).

hybridRejected.name: profileV4TamperedEd25519Signature
hybridRejected.description: Strict-AND: a single bit flip in the Ed25519 signature must fail even when ML-DSA-65 is valid (§13.2).

hybridRejected.name: profileV4TamperedMldsa65Signature
hybridRejected.description: Strict-AND: a single bit flip in the ML-DSA-65 signature must fail even when Ed25519 is valid (§13.2).

hybridRejected.name: profileV4WrongMldsaContext
hybridRejected.description: ML-DSA-65 signature created with the v3 context string instead of palexplorer-private-network-v4 must fail (§13.2).

hybridRejected.name: profileV4ActiveMemberMissingDsaKey
hybridRejected.description: An active unrevoked member in a v4 profile must carry a 3,904-hex dsaPublicKey (§13.1).

hybridRejected.name: profileV3DowngradeAfterV4
hybridRejected.description: Once a v4 profile has been accepted for an administrator, a subsequent v3 profile must be rejected even with a higher version (§13.2).

hybridRejected.name: handoverV2TamperedEd25519Signature
hybridRejected.description: Strict-AND: a bit flip in the handover v2 Ed25519 signature must fail (§13.3).

hybridRejected.name: handoverV2TamperedMldsa65Signature
hybridRejected.description: Strict-AND: a bit flip in the handover v2 ML-DSA-65 signature must fail (§13.3).

hybridRejected.name: handoverV2WrongMldsaContext
hybridRejected.description: ML-DSA-65 handover signature under the wrong context string must fail (§13.3).

hybridRejected.name: handoverV1DowngradeAfterV4
hybridRejected.description: Once a v4 profile has been accepted for a network, a v1 handover must be rejected (§13.3).
